Termio: per-Surface I/O and emulation (src/termio/Termio.zig)
|
|-- mailbox: incoming writes, resize and configuration
|   `-- Surface.io_thread drains -> queueWrite -> Backend.queueWrite
|-- backend: Backend.exec = Exec (src/termio/Exec.zig)
|   |-- Subprocess: PTY + configured shell/command; start opens/launches
|   |-- Read workers: POSIX io-gather -> bounded buffers -> io-reader
|   |   `-- Windows instead reads and processes serially
|   `-- reader -> processOutput(bytes); yieldToDemand between batches
|-- terminal_stream: terminal.Stream(StreamHandler)
|   |-- Parser: incremental VT byte interpretation
|   `-- StreamHandler (src/termio/stream_handler.zig)
|       |-- retained APC / DCS protocol state; terminal reference
|       |-- VT operations -> terminal below
|       |-- protocol replies -> termio mailbox -> PTY write path
|       `-- surface_mailbox -> App.mailbox -> live Surface.handleMessage
|-- terminal: Terminal (src/terminal/Terminal.zig); renderer-independent
|   |-- geometry / tabstops / modes / cursor style / colors / title / pwd
|   `-- screens: ScreenSet (src/terminal/ScreenSet.zig)
|       |-- primary Screen; alternate Screen created on demand
|       |   |-- cursor / saved_cursor / selection / charset
|       |   |-- kitty_keyboard / kitty_images / semantic_prompt / dirty
|       |   `-- pages: PageList (src/terminal/PageList.zig)
|       |       |-- ordered pages: scrollback through active screen
|       |       |   `-- rows / cells (src/terminal/page.zig)
|       |       `-- tracked pins: viewport / cursor / selection locations
|       `-- active: reference to selected Screen, not a third Screen
|-- processOutput: lock Surface.renderer_state.mutex
|   |-- queueRender -> renderer wakeup (scheduled while lock is held)
|   `-- terminal_stream.nextSlice(bytes) -> mutate terminal; unlock
`-- resize: coalesced by Surface.io_thread
    |-- under same terminal lock: Backend.resize then Terminal.resize
    |   `-- child redraw cannot be parsed with obsolete dimensions
    `-- renderer mailbox .resize + wakeup -> display geometry
